  • Classes
    Class
    Description
    AllocationResult
    The AllocationResult is the object returned by a region allocation or a hot-page growth.
    AllocationStatus
    The AllocationStatus type holds the integer codes an allocation can return.
    BitAddress
    The BitAddress is a view of one range inside a page.
    DecodedFrame
    The DecodedFrame is one message copied onto the heap from a stored frame.
    FrameType
    The FrameType type holds the byte that names what a frame contains.
    HealthReport
    The HealthReport is the object returned by an integrity check of one region.
    IndexEntry
    The IndexEntry is one index row copied onto the heap.
    LockLevel
    The LockLevel type holds the integer stored on an operator lock.
    LockToken
    The LockToken is the handle returned when an operator lock is taken.
    MemoryAddress
    The MemoryAddress is a byte range inside one page.
    MemoryTelemetry
    The MemoryTelemetry is a frozen copy of the process counters.
    MessageInspect
    The MessageInspect is a read-only view of one stored message.
    OperationResult
    The OperationResult is the object returned by a call that changes stored bytes.
    OperationStatus
    The OperationStatus type holds the integer codes a changing call can return.
    PageFlags
    The PageFlags type holds the bit values stored in a page header.
    RegionDescriptor
    The RegionDescriptor is a copy of one region's layout for a caller to read.
    Role
    The Role type holds the byte stored for who sent a message.
    SnapshotHandle
    The SnapshotHandle is the id of one stored snapshot.
    SnapshotOptions
    The SnapshotOptions type holds the choices for one snapshot.
